notes.title: Diamond Dan Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Diamond Dan have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Fixed non-ascii steam usernames breaking scoreboards
Fixed "Narrow Escape" achievement

notes.title: New Release - Diamond Dan
notes.notes:
Diamond Dan is now available on Steam!  Treasure maps and hidden treasure await Dan in the dangerous temples.  Archeology at it's best!

Addictive casual platform game with a twist!
